dedupe_keys.name: gridinspector osm power grid quality tools

description: GridInspector is Dynartio's set of analysis tools for assessing OpenStreetMap power-grid data within the MapYourGrid initiative. Its repository describes scripts for power-line and circuit lengths, international interconnectors, source cross-checks and a global indicator-map dataset. Inputs are OSM extracts and comparison sources; outputs are quality measures, tabular summaries and map layers. Spatial coverage can be global or limited to a chosen country or feature, while dates reflect the underlying OSM snapshots. The MIT-licensed code is free on GitHub, and the README points to a separate extraction repository and a rendered indicator map. A limitation is that many results measure mapping completeness and consistency, not actual electrical performance. The repository also includes prototyping folders, so users should choose the documented analysis step they need. It can help assess whether an OSM-derived grid is suitable as an input to topology or resilience simulation. The existing data-open-infrastructure-map is another view of mapped assets, but this tool produces quality indicators, not a finished grid model. The scripts were not run.
name: GridInspector OSM power-grid quality tools
